label: Summarise this PR in plain English
description: Explain what this pull request does and why, without jargon.
promptTemplate:
You are a senior engineer using Kimi 3. Summarise the following pull request in plain English for a busy reviewer.

Respond in Markdown with:
1. One-sentence summary
2. What changed (bullet points)
3. Why it likely matters / potential impact

label: Suggest refactors and cleanup
description: Propose concrete refactors to improve readability and maintainability.
promptTemplate:
You are a staff engineer using Kimi 3. Review the following file and suggest refactors and cleanup.

Respond in Markdown with:
1. Quick wins (low risk)
2. Structural refactors (with before/after where useful)
3. Naming / readability notes

Only suggest changes that preserve behaviour unless you flag them clearly.
